fields.x_execution_input_contract:
Required before material capability transfer/reuse: Context; Work Object/state revision; Goal Anchor; source capability/artifact identity and version; source Context; owning Service and Service lineage; source evidence/provenance; applicable Method/Pattern; applicable prior decisions; source authority ceiling; reusable invariants separated from source-specific configuration; receiving Context; proposed adaptations; receiving-context evidence gaps; Outcome/Benefit/Asset relationship; acceptance/reuse criteria; replay identity. Missing or conflicting decision-changing evidence remains explicit and may HOLD only the affected transfer.

[KCBR-1] For reuse of a kinematic challenge capability, require the source challenge specimen, reusable control invariants, source-specific vectors/conditions separated explicitly, receiving-Context vector substitutions, receiving blast radius and new local evidence/authority required.

[RFL-1] Relationship-first lens supplement: when one authoritative capability/work/value element must appear in multiple authorised Context/Offering lenses, identify the single owner Context, the interested/applicable lens relationship, the governing Service/Programme/Work/Asset source chain, the Offering steward where applicable, the containment boundary, paired count/action projection, exact rollback path and replay identity. Reuse existing Service Catalogue relations before adding new classification fields. Visibility never grants authority, PPV movement, Benefit realisation, Asset qualification or ACL inheritance.

[AUTH-BROWSER-INTEGRATION-GOVERNANCE-V1] Capability-reuse input additionally requires source platform/profile class, reusable invariants, source-specific login/session conditions separated explicitly, receiving platform/Context, permission delta, security/privacy differences, new negative controls and evidence required. Secrets/session tokens are never transferable artefacts.

[MESH-HEALTH-CONTEXTUAL-FITNESS-V1]
For every material Mesh Health assessment resolve two layers separately: (A) universal invariants — state/replay integrity, Context separation, evidence/provenance truth, expected-return identity, authority/STOP-HOLD preservation, bounded action and no false PPV/Benefit/Asset/canon movement; and (B) a Context-specific health envelope — purpose, environment, expected phenotype/configuration, required Services/sensors/gates/memory/AI/authority, useful-neutral-harmful variation tolerances, differentiation state, expected Flow, exit/recycle condition and cycle-2 learning test. Do not infer health from one fixed target shape. Quality objective: MAXIMUM APPRECIATION / MINIMUM HARMFUL VARIATION.

[PTW-EVENTS-V1]
For material strategy sensing, select the applicable governed Playing to Win target event from x_ss_playing_to_win_event rather than inventing free-text event classes. The event is a reference signal, not authority. Resolve affected choice (Winning Aspiration, Where to Play, How to Win, Capabilities, Management Systems or cross-choice), Context evidence, strategy question, Mesh response and authority boundary.

[PTW-PERSISTENT-EVOLVE-RADAR-V1]
AGT-EVOLVE-PTW-01 scans active Contexts against PTW-EVENTS-V1. Resolve Context, strategy, work, signals, opportunities, outcomes, benefits, assets and evidence. Qualify the PTW event, contextual fitness, opportunity and expected-asset linkage, and potential asset-quality contribution. De-duplicate before routing.

[PTW-RECURSIVE-OPTIONALITY-ANTIFRAGILITY-V1]
For each material PTW candidate, AGT-EVOLVE-PTW-01 must resolve a sparse option set rather than a single assumed route. Where real alternatives exist, state at least two bounded options plus HOLD/NO-OP when materially valid; never manufacture options to meet a count. For each option record purpose/strategy/asset contribution, evidence maturity, reversibility, dependencies, switching cost, disproof/switching evidence, blast radius, authority ceiling, expected observation and exit/recycle condition. Preserve future-option state without treating it as prediction or authority. Select only a bounded reversible test within current authority. Perturbation may be contradiction, evidence-source loss, provider failure, delayed return, changed market/partner condition, option dominance change or local capability failure. Preserve completed work and switch only the affected route.

[PTW-PREDICTABILITY-GTM-V1] A predictive or Realisation-Confidence relationship may be reused only when its source envelope is explicit: source Context/Service, intervention/activity, mechanism, kinematic cluster, information horizon, evidence/calibration history, conditions/invariants, Context-specific variables, disproof/switching conditions and receiving-Context differences. Historical-cutoff/frozen-model backtests may support transferability evidence but do not substitute for receiving-Context evidence. Match future opportunities to demonstrated relationships at the component/cluster level rather than transferring a whole-Context confidence score.

[GEODESIC-MESH-TEST-REGIME-V1] Before reusing a purportedly general mechanism, apply PERSISTENCE_ACROSS_RESOLUTION across relevant aperture/depth choices and record persistence, transformation or disappearance. Where material, observe ACTIVE_LOAD_PATH using traceable dependency/evidence/value load rather than topology counts, and DEGENERATE_SUBSTITUTION by comparing fallback dependencies and failure modes rather than duplicate instance count.

[VERIFIABLE-AI-DISCOVERY-V1]
Before reusing an AI-enabled capability, require its generation/verification envelope: candidate-generation process, independent verifier(s), verifier coverage, success/failure evidence, human interpretation/significance gate, compute/effort, reproducibility, source-domain constraints and receiving-context transfer evidence.
fields.x_description:
Capability encoding and reuse. Community engagement and capability transfer service for collaborative programmes. Manages outreach, events, and reusable capability artifacts. PPV blocking: engagement below minimum threshold blocks activation; communication not context-bound triggers Gate 1 rejection.

[CIC-COLLAB-DEPTH-LOCK-V1] Reuse/learning contract. Capture collaborator interaction-depth selection, onboarding friction, security/access defects, lock/recommendation usability, cross-surface semantic drift, AI misunderstanding and accepted/rejected recommendation patterns as reusable learning. Reuse the same interaction-depth and content-control contract across Contexts; do not fork per organisation except approved configuration.

[AUTH-BROWSER-INTEGRATION-GOVERNANCE-V1] Reusable capability encoding contract. Encode a portable Authenticated Browser/Integration Access Profile pattern that separates non-secret profile metadata from provider-held credentials, preserves Context/Service/mode/authority semantics, and supports reuse across Odoo, 3DEXPERIENCE, industry platforms and future systems. Reuse approved evidence/test packs without copying credentials or source-specific session state.

[EVOLVE-AI-COWORKER-V0.1] Reuse D002-EAI candidate + PAT-EVOLVE-AICW-01 to encode provider-neutral collaborator AI CoWorker onboarding and recursive situational-awareness learning. Claude/CoWork is first runtime profile only. Known -> Assess -> Infer -> Route -> Observe -> Learn -> Assetise; admission remains evidence-dependent.
fields.x_context_binding_notes: ACTIVATION: Requires community engagement programme initiated + confirmed participant pool. Prior: SC-01 (community members sourced from learning cohorts). No additional D001 approval required. Registers: res.partner, crm.lead. WORKFLOW BINDING: W1 (opportunity intake), W13 (orphan scan weekly). ODOO APPS: CRM, Contacts, Email Marketing, Marketing Automation.

[KCBR-1] Also return: challenge_invariants; source_specific_vectors; receiving_context_vectors; receiving_blast_radius; receiving_kinematic_aperture; transfer_test_result; redesign_effort_change; implementation_uncertainty_change.

[OBA-MESH-V1] MATERIAL VALUE RETURN. Treat Outcome, Benefit and enduring Asset as three reflective libraries over one evidence graph. Return: outcome_identity/state and changed-condition evidence; linked Benefit identity with beneficiary, baseline, target, source/measure, horizon, causal Offering/Service contribution, evidence threshold, Realisation state and harmful-variation check; linked Asset carrier with persistence, rights/control, reuse, defensibility, productive capability/value, evidence and Benefit relationship; perspective_delta for industry/reference, SynapSys contract and participant evidence; current revalidation/persistence/impairment state; exactly one next proof. Activity/output is not sufficient evidence of Outcome, Benefit or Asset.

fields.x_adaptability_envelope:
Reusable capability may be transferred across Contexts, AI providers, runtimes, platforms, evidence substrates and interfaces only when the governing Service semantics, provenance, authority ceiling, evidence requirements, Outcome/Benefit/Asset distinctions and replay identity remain intact. The receiving Context must state source invariants, local adaptations, new evidence and unresolved variance. Transfer may simplify or reconfigure implementation but may not silently weaken claim strength, authority, provenance, acceptance criteria or required controls.

[UCGEC-1] Adaptability may vary route, sequencing, question depth and kinematic aperture inside the current Goal Anchor, evidence, authority and blast radius. Expansion requires an evidenced trigger. It may not manufacture authority, cross a membrane silently, alter Goal Anchor/canon/PPV/Benefit/Asset state, or broaden irreversible/external scope. Preserve optionality, reversibility and completed delta.

[UCGEC-1.1] FPV/adaptability applies at both cluster and sub-gate level. May vary route, sequencing, concurrency, question depth, provider/runtime, topology and aperture only inside current Goal Anchor, evidence, authority and authorised blast radius. Preserve optionality/reversibility. Expand radius/topology/aperture only on evidenced trigger with affected state, authority, rollback/replay and refreshed return; collapse/merge gates as uncertainty resolves. Never manufacture authority or silently promote PPV/canon/Service/Method/Pattern/Benefit/Asset state.
fields.x_deterministic_tech_requirements:
For material reuse/transfer: source identity/version and provenance capture; contract/schema compatibility check; invariant-vs-adaptation diff; authority-state validation; evidence/reference integrity check; replay identity; positive and negative reuse test where applicable; exact readback/receipt for protected implementation.

[KCBR-1] For challenge reuse validate source/receiving Context identity, invariant-vs-local diff, receiving vectors, blast radius, new evidence/authority, transfer test and replay identity.
fields.x_human_role_requirements: Human/Steward authority remains required for material policy or scope change, binding external commitment, risk acceptance, canon/PPV/Benefit/Asset promotion, confidentiality override, or protected mutation beyond existing D007 authority. Provider substitution alone is not a human decision when the existing contract and authority remain satisfied.
fields.x_execution_profile_requirements:
[UCGEC-1] Inherit GOAL_TO_MESHGATE_DECISION_PACKAGE_v1.0. Resolve Context, Work Object/state, Goal Anchor, current goal step/completion, evidence-bound material Signal, REQUIRED_NOW Service/Method/Pattern/SOP/Skill/runtime, PPV/evidence/reality/authority, target MeshGate/Mesh stage, blast radius LOCAL|CONTEXT|CROSS_CONTEXT|ENTERPRISE_SYSTEMIC, smallest sufficient kinematic aperture, FPV/adaptability envelope, expected return, rollback/replay and one NEXT/HOLD. Continue recursively after filing/PASS/return/local completion until target gate/Goal Anchor completion or genuine HOLD/Steward escalation. UCGEC-1 does not substitute for missing Service-specific input/outcome/return/FFE/validation contracts and does not change lifecycle state.

[UCGEC-1.1] Inherit SERVICE_CATALOGUE_UCGEC_1_1_MESHGATE_CLUSTER_PROGRESSION_CONTROL_v1.1. For every progression/package resolve current Goal Anchor/state, qualify decision-relevant Signal, determine MeshGate topology SINGLE_MESHGATE|PARENT_WITH_SUBGATES|KINEMATIC_MESHGATE_CLUSTER, define parent/cluster exit condition, materially distinct sub-gates, dependencies, serial/parallel eligibility, REQUIRED_NOW capability chain, cluster/sub-gate blast radii, cluster/sub-gate kinematic apertures, FPV/adaptability envelope, exact returns and recombination rule. Continue through eligible sub-gates and subsequent gate/cluster progression until Goal Anchor completion or genuine Steward escalation. A sub-gate PASS, filed artefact, local completion or recoverable failure is not a default stop.

[UCGEC-1.3] Inherit SERVICE_CATALOGUE_UCGEC_1_3_GOVERNED_JOB_OBSERVABILITY_AND_TRACEABILITY_v1.0. For each material governed invocation/cross-lane/domain movement, create/update the existing durable Service Execution Run receipt where applicable before substantive execution; bind current Work Object/Context/Service/state/expected return; project status, FFE, evidence-bound priority, MeshGate/cluster, REQUIRED_NOW participants, blast/aperture/adaptation and NEXT/HOLD; preserve PREPARED/FILED/DISPATCHED/CLAIMED/IN_PROGRESS/RETURNED/CONSUMED distinctions. Observability never grants Service eligibility or authority. Exact-source projection repair may self-correct only within released observability scope; otherwise expose STALE/MISSING/CONFLICTING.

[ADAPTIVE-VERB-TEMPLATE-ROLLOUT-V1] Encode approved adaptive verb templates as reusable versioned capability artifacts with invariant semantics separated from Context/surface configuration. Never copy source-specific hard-coded text or authority.
fields.x_provider_fallback_policy:
Resolve transfer by required capability and evidence access, not provider brand. Prefer an already-authorised capability-equivalent provider/runtime/substrate; preserve the source contract and completed evidence; fail over only the affected operation. If no eligible alternative preserves semantics, provenance, authority and replay, return SERVICE_EXECUTION_GAP/HOLD rather than degrade the contract.

[UCGEC-1] Use capability-equivalent provider/runtime fallback while preserving exact state/evidence/authority/expected-return identity. After two failed attempts in the same runtime/transport class, change authorised route rather than repeat blindly. Provider friction alone is not a Steward decision.

[UCGEC-1.1] If one sub-gate/provider/runtime fails, preserve completed and independent eligible gates; fail over only the failed operation/route. A held sub-gate does not freeze unrelated eligible sub-gates. After two failures in the same runtime/transport class, change authorised route rather than repeat blindly. Steward transport is last resort.
fields.x_authority_gate_schema:
Preparation, encoding design, validation and bounded filing may proceed within authority. Canonical promotion, Method/Pattern/Service/Asset status change, PPV/Benefit promotion or protected system mutation requires applicable Steward/D001/D007 authority. Exhaust safe validation before decision escalation.

[UCGEC-1] Gate Submission is progression, not default Steward return. Escalate only for a material evidenced authority/binding act, unresolved strategic choice, exhausted decision-changing evidence, canonical contradiction, membrane consent/commitment, out-of-envelope regulatory/contractual/ethical/financial/safety exposure, insufficient PPV/evidence for irreversible movement, inadequate kinematic containment, Purpose/Strategy/Asset perturbation needing human choice, or canon/enduring-Asset/authority-architecture/irreversible external change. Otherwise continue.

[UCGEC-1.1] Parent/sub-gate/cluster progression continues without Steward interruption while evidence, authority and blast-radius containment remain valid. Escalate only for a material new binding authority/external commitment, unresolved strategic choice, exhausted decision-changing evidence, canonical contradiction, membrane consent, out-of-envelope legal/financial/safety exposure, insufficient evidence for irreversible movement, inadequate kinematic containment, Purpose/Strategy/Asset perturbation requiring human choice, or canon/enduring-Asset/authority-architecture change.

[UCGEC-1.2] A standalone direct Steward utterance "Continue" is mutation authority for exactly one current bounded mutation when canonical state/replay are current; the mutation or unambiguous bounded mutation cluster is already explicit; affected objects/fields, prestate, rollback/containment, readback/acceptance and expected return are defined; and there is no competing mutation, stale-state conflict, canonical contradiction or material scope ambiguity. On receipt, the controller SHALL issue/file the exact D007 release identity and execute without asking again. A "Continue" scope qualifier may identify or narrow that same resolved mutation but may not silently broaden it. "Continue" does not by itself authorise an unbounded/different mutation, payment/purchase, new external legal/commercial commitment, credential/security weakening, scope expansion beyond the tested blast radius, or PPV/Benefit/Asset/Method/Pattern/Service-lifecycle/canon promotion. If these conditions fail, continue only already-authorised work and return the precise HOLD. Source control: SERVICE_CATALOGUE_UCGEC_1_2_STEWARD_CONTINUE_MUTATION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.

[EXT-COMMS-PHIL-ONLY-20260924] External communication control. AI/Agent/Service lanes SHALL NOT send, email, message, invite, submit, lodge, publish or otherwise transmit externally. When external communication is the next valid action, the Service SHALL prepare the communication/artefact, create or update a Philip Nyssen-owned Odoo project task with recipient, purpose, attachments, blockers and release conditions, and HOLD transmission for Philip Nyssen to issue manually. Internal "Continue" or Service progression does not grant external-send authority. A different external sender or automated send requires a later standalone direct authority utterance for that exact action. Source: direct Steward instruction 2026-09-24.

[AUTH-BROWSER-INTEGRATION-GOVERNANCE-V1] Reuse never inherits access or authority. Each receiving platform/Context must re-establish identity, permissions, session and mutation authority locally. No credential copying between providers/platforms.

[PTW-PREDICTABILITY-GTM-V1] Reuse does not inherit confidence, authority or PPV. A relationship demonstrated in one Context remains bounded to its evidence envelope until receiving-Context evidence supports extrapolation. Model agreement, repetition or retrospective fit alone does not create a reusable Method/Pattern/Service/canonical predictive claim.

[GEODESIC-MESH-TEST-REGIME-V1] Single-resolution appearance, topology count or duplicate instances do not establish universal transferability, criticality or resilient substitution. Receiving-Context evidence remains required.
fields.x_return_acceptance_schema:
Accept only when all seven transferability conditions are evidenced: (1) source lineage identifiable; (2) reusable invariants separated from source-specific conditions; (3) receiving Context adapts rather than copies; (4) owning Service contribution remains traceable; (5) evidence and authority are re-established locally and not inherited automatically; (6) observation/learning returns without silently changing source state or canon; (7) practical transfer benefit is measured through reduced redesign, implementation uncertainty or marginal delivery effort where applicable. Also require expected Work Object/state/return match, provenance/scope preservation, Outcome/Benefit/Asset separation, authority compliance and exactly one NEXT/HOLD. Reject stale, duplicate, mismatched, silently promoted or provider-locked transfers.

[UCGEC-1] Return supplement: consumed state revision, target gate, blast-radius class, kinematic aperture, completed/remaining delta, evidence/reality/PPV/authority, movement/result, perturbation, learning, next Gate Submission or precise escalation, exactly one next action and replay-validity.

[UCGEC-1.1] Cluster return supplement: consumed_state_revision; gate_or_cluster_id; parent_gate; meshgate_topology; strong_signal_state/evidence; canonical_requirements; cluster_exit_condition; sub_gates; dependencies; serial_parallel_eligibility; cluster_blast_radius; sub_gate_blast_radii; cluster_kinematic_aperture; sub_gate_apertures; completed/remaining delta; evidence/reality/PPV/authority; closed_sub_gates; held_sub_gates; still_eligible_sub_gates; recombination_result; perturbation; learning; next_gate_or_cluster; exactly_one_next_action; replay_validity. Partial returns close only their slice and never reset the cluster.

[KCBR-1] Reject transfer that copies source-specific legal/commercial facts as universal controls, inherits authority/evidence without re-establishment, or fails to test the receiving Context's own vectors and blast radius.

[RFL-1] Relationship-lens acceptance supplement: require one-source-record proof; owner-versus-lens separation; count/action reconciliation from the same Odoo relationship graph; one reversible upstream relationship perturbation with exact restore; suspended/non-steward Context containment; unchanged ACL/ir.rule and lifecycle/authority state; and explicit evidence that AI/N8N are not copying presentation values where Odoo relationships/query-on-read can provide the result.

[UCGEC-1.3] Return observability supplement: accept a material return only when Run Receipt/Work Object/Context/state/authority/expected-return identities match; update only completed/remaining delta, gate/cluster, participants, evidence/reality/PPV/authority, perturbation/recovery, next transition and replay-validity. FILED/RETURNED is not CONSUMED. Reject stale, wrong-lane, duplicate-accepted, replay-conflicting or authority-variant returns while preserving completed independent work.

[OBA-MESH-V1] Accept material value claims only when Outcome -> Benefit -> Asset lineage is explicit at the current evidence ceiling. Reject activity/output represented as Outcome without changed condition; Outcome represented as Benefit without beneficiary/measurement/value; Benefit represented as Asset without persistence/rights/reuse/productive-value evidence; historical designation assumed permanently current; or participant/reference assertion treated as verified solely because submitted. A revalidation or impairment finding may lower the current evidence ceiling without deleting lineage.

[MESH-HEALTH-CONTEXTUAL-FITNESS-V1 ACCEPTANCE]
Accept a positive Mesh Health conclusion only when invariant health and contextual fitness are both explicit. Required measures, selected sparsely where material: integrity; topology; signal health; memory; intelligence/evidence diversity; Flow; adaptability/recovery; learning yield; Outcome->Benefit->Asset conversion; tensegrity/trade-off effects; differentiation fitness; recycling/reuse. A healthy authority HOLD, human decision boundary or alternative validated phenotype must not be scored as a defect merely because it differs from a universal shape. Package/narrative presence alone is insufficient. Missing phenotype, false authority expansion, unbounded harmful variation, or no cycle-2 evidence for a claimed learned improvement => HOLD/NOT_VERIFIED for that claim.

[PTW-EVENTS-V1 ACCEPTANCE]
A strategy-event response must reference the controlled PTW event code/name when applicable, preserve evidence/reality/PPV/authority separation, and test the affected Playing to Win choice against current Context. Event selection alone cannot authorise strategy adoption/retirement, external action, PPV/Benefit/Asset/canon movement or protected mutation. No duplicate static event taxonomy is accepted where the governed reference model is available.

[PTW-PERSISTENT-EVOLVE-RADAR-V1 ACCEPTANCE]
Require Context and source identity, one governed PTW event, candidate-level evidence, affected strategy choice, opportunity and asset link or UNKNOWN, and one bounded next action. Candidate signals only. No authority or value-state movement.

[PTW-RECURSIVE-OPTIONALITY-ANTIFRAGILITY-V1 ACCEPTANCE]
Accept recursive capability only when the agent can operate from durable Service/Agent/state contracts without conversation-thread reasoning; identify the material PTW event; produce a Context-fit option set; preserve reversible optionality; name switching/disproof evidence; run or specify a bounded perturbation; recover/reconfigure without restarting unaffected work; observe actual versus expected result; and update the next traversal from learning. Antifragility requires demonstrated subsequent improvement after perturbation, not resilience language alone. No automatic Strategy, Asset, Benefit, PPV, canon or external commitment movement.

[ADAPTIVE-VERB-TEMPLATE-ROLLOUT-V1] Reject reuse when template identity/version, invariant set, receiving Context adaptation, supporting data compatibility or semantic invariance are not evidenced.

[VERIFIABLE-AI-DISCOVERY-V1] Reuse is accepted only when correctness evidence is separated from significance/value evidence; surviving outputs are not treated as the capability denominator; verifier limitations and failure evidence are preserved; receiving-context evidence tests transfer; and practical reuse benefit is measured. Benchmark-domain verification does not generalise automatically.
fields.x_observation_learning_contract:
Observe actual reuse across Contexts/providers/runtimes/substrates; adoption; defects; semantic drift; provenance loss; authority leakage; replay failure; version drift; duplicate capability; redesign effort; implementation uncertainty; marginal delivery effort; fallback quality; recovery effort; Outcome/Benefit contribution and enduring Asset durability. Route validated learning to SC-05/SC-07 and owning Services; repetition alone does not promote. A bounded perturbation should improve optionality, routing, evidence or reusable capability before it is described as antifragile.

[UCGEC-1] After each material movement capture observed vs expected result, perturbation, false HOLD/PROCEED, provider/evidence friction, blast-radius or kinematic change, reusable learning and owning improvement route. Feed validated learning to the owning Service, then Method/Pattern/Skill/controller and cross-Service Catalogue improvement where material; no silent promotion.

[UCGEC-1.1] Observe planned-vs-actual gate topology, Signal quality, serial bottlenecks, unnecessary/missing gates, blast-radius/aperture errors, false HOLD/PROCEED, return mismatches, provider friction, perturbation and cluster recombination quality. Route reusable correction to owning Service then Method/Pattern/Skill/controller and cross-Service Catalogue improvement; repetition without control improvement is not learning.

[RFL-1] Observe direct-versus-derived relationship drift, duplicated classification, stale presentation counters, owner/lens ambiguity, count/action divergence, cross-Context leakage, suspended-Context leakage and unnecessary propagation automation. Prefer correction in authoritative Odoo relations or computed/query-on-read lenses; retain N8N as validator/exception infrastructure unless separate evidence justifies automation.

[UCGEC-1.3] Observation/learning supplement: capture projection freshness, runtime drift, retries/fallbacks, perturbations, recoveries and outcomes as evidence-bound observations; classify projection CURRENT|STALE|MISSING|CONFLICTING; route reusable learning to the owning existing Service/Method/Pattern/Skill/runtime candidate. Do not silently promote Service lifecycle, canon, PPV, Benefit or Asset state.

[AUTH-BROWSER-INTEGRATION-GOVERNANCE-V1] Capture reusable profile schemas, login/session failure modes, browser test packs, provider substitution evidence, cost/reliability observations and platform-specific exceptions. Measure reduced manual screenshot burden and regression latency without weakening assurance.

[OBA-MESH-V1] Observe OBA graph quality over time: stale baselines, changing standards, beneficiary relevance, failed persistence, reversal, harmful variation, Asset impairment/supersession, disagreement between industry/reference, SynapSys and participant evidence, and double-count risk. Preserve contrary perspectives as evidence-bearing challenge signals. Route validated learning through existing SC-04/SC-07/CIAL paths; no silent PPV, Benefit, Asset, Pattern, Method, Service or canon promotion.

[MESH-HEALTH-CONTEXTUAL-FITNESS-V1 FEEDBACK]
For each material traversal capture Observed vs Expected; classify variance USEFUL | NEUTRAL | HARMFUL; identify Context/phenotype and affected invariant; record evidence maturity; derive bounded learning; route adaptation to the owning existing Service then Method/Pattern/Skill/runtime candidate; test the next applicable traversal; and classify learning OBSERVED | CANDIDATE | IMPLEMENTED | CYCLE2_VERIFIED. Measure trajectory STRENGTHENING | STABLE | WEAKENING, false-defect/false-proceed rate, recovery time, learning yield, perturbation gain, reuse, supersession/retirement, operator burden and Benefit/Asset conversion. Learning is realised only when subsequent behaviour improves. Preserve useful capability and provenance while recycling/superseding obsolete Form. No silent promotion.

[PTW-EVENTS-V1 FEEDBACK]
Observe whether the selected event clarified the strategic choice, reduced false persistence or false switching, improved option quality, exposed capability/management-system gaps, captured positive deviation, or enabled deliberate retirement/recycling. Feed observations through Mesh Health contextual fitness and cycle-2 comparison. Retain one governed event register; improve event definitions from verified learning rather than proliferating local lists.

[PTW-PERSISTENT-EVOLVE-RADAR-V1 LEARNING]
Observe signal yield, false positives and negatives, duplicates, evidence diversity, qualification latency, strategy clarity, outcome-benefit-asset progression, asset-quality evidence improvement, reuse, operator burden and cycle-2 improvement. Feed verified learning through Evolve without silent promotion.

[PTW-RECURSIVE-OPTIONALITY-ANTIFRAGILITY-V1 LEARNING]
After each material perturbation capture option set before/after, selected bounded test, perturbation, route switched or preserved, recovery time, evidence gained/lost, harmful/useful/neutral variation, opportunity cost, option value retained, result, learning and cycle-2 effect. Classify learning OBSERVED|CANDIDATE|IMPLEMENTED|CYCLE2_VERIFIED and trajectory STRENGTHENING|STABLE|WEAKENING. Reuse verified learning across eligible Contexts through SC-04/SC-07; route assurance through SC-05/SB-05 and governance through GV-GOV-004.
